findings.summary: Extension control/status speech runs over an actively playing lecture instead of preserving the original pause-for-guidance and resume-after-guidance behavior.
findings.fix: Add optional playback coordination for the currently owned connected media view: acknowledge pause before UI speech, remember prior playing state, and resume only after the latest guidance ends with unchanged lesson/session/fence. Keep login guidance independent of any media lease.
findings.evidence: Original holdPlayback/releasePlayback save and restore playback; StudentAnnouncer has no media pause/resume hooks and busy() only checks lesson speech/recognition.

findings.summary: External-reader mode no longer pauses lecture playback when the student moves focus, so original protection against simultaneous lecture audio and screen-reader speech is lost.
findings.fix: On student focus navigation in reader mode, pause currently owned playing media without auto-resuming; let the student explicitly resume. Do not claim a different media view or infer OS screen-reader speech completion.
findings.evidence: Original readerMode focusin pauses running playback. Extension focusin only calls announcer.say(), which immediately returns in reader_mode.

findings.summary: Voice and typed commands cannot be opened before selecting a lesson, preventing original home-screen commands such as opening the first lecture or asking for help.
findings.fix: Expose student-wide voice/typed command entry on the home screen, allow Space command entry without a selected lesson, and handle help/list/open-lecture before needLesson(). Keep playback actions guarded when no lesson is loaded.
findings.evidence: Command forms/buttons are descendants of hidden #lesson; Space handlers require hasLesson(); command() calls needLesson() before the help branch.
findings.component: Student home voice and typed commands

findings.summary: Extension narration loses the original automatic ranking of Korean Natural/Neural/Online voices and can choose a different default voice from control guidance.
findings.fix: Extract the original pure Korean voice scoring/selection helpers into a shared speech module; use the same selected-or-ranked fallback for narration and UI guidance, preserve explicit user voice choice, and refresh safely when voices load.
findings.evidence: Original voiceScore ranks natural/neural/online and named Korean voices. StudentSpeech only sets an exact saved voice; StudentAnnouncer otherwise takes the first Korean voice.

findings.summary: Original text-pronunciation normalization, sentence-based breath pauses, opening/closing prosody and warm/calm/clear profiles are replaced with fixed 180-character narration chunks.
findings.fix: Port pure text normalization and sentence/prosody profiles while retaining extension cancellation/fence safety. Add an equivalent narration preview if retaining advanced profiles. Document that original profile/preview controls were hidden in student role; the default speech engine behavior still requires parity.
findings.evidence: Original prepareSpeechText, speechChunks, styleProfile and 70/130ms pauses are absent; extension applies constant rate/pitch to arbitrary 180-character chunks.
findings.component: Natural narration engine and advanced preview

findings.summary: Disabling the answer-speech checkbox does not mute typed answers when focus guidance remains enabled, unlike the original independent answer and focus speech choices.
findings.fix: Remove focus_voice as an override of the explicit answer-speech preference; retain forced speech only for explicit spoken/read-aloud requests. When answer speech is off, provide the result via a reader announcement or managed result focus without speaking it through focus guidance.
findings.evidence: Extension ask() condition includes forceSpeak || speak-answer.checked || settings.focus_voice; original auto-speak-chat was independent of focusVoice.

passed: Extension retains speed, volume, pitch and explicit Korean-voice selection plus per-device preference storage.
Lesson narration still pauses playback before output and uses generation/fence checks before resuming.
External-reader lesson-description delivery avoids browser TTS and does not guess reader completion to resume playback.
App guidance now covers login/home controls and protects password field contents.
Typed, speech-recognition and local fallback command engines remain present for an opened lesson.
Current reader-mode ordinary answers have a single full-answer delivery channel.
notes: Functional parity audit, not a complete WCAG audit. All findings use n/a because they concern implemented product behavior rather than asserted conformance failures.
No actual Korean audio, VoiceOver or NVDA was heard or executed.

Original advanced speech-style/voice-preview controls live in .player-tools, which styles.css:674 hides for student role; only speed, volume and auto-narration are moved to student preferences. Their engine effects still run by default.

Original Mac native initial-login greeting is replaced with browser focus speech and an explicit start/test control. This is a changed platform boundary; automatic first audio after reload is not established by source inspection.
Neither original nor extension reader mode starts or detects an OS screen reader.
Persisted accompanying detailed parity notes to live-parity-notes.md.
